before: The review rail listed comments and tracked changes as cards, and collapsed comment markers drew the comment icon. Only format and structural changes opened a page balloon. A review column that did not fit beside the page collapsed to a marker strip, and an open review or navigation pane shrank a capped fit.
after: Three viewer preferences, revisionsIn, commentMarkers, and paneOverflow, choose whether tracked changes are rail cards or page balloons, how collapsed comment markers look, and whether a review column that does not fit keeps the page size and scrolls sideways. getActivatedReviewKey reads whether the active review item was opened explicitly. The comment reply box draws as a compact reply line.
reason: All three preferences are local revision markup view state, never written to the document or shared with other participants; paneOverflow changes only the local scroller padding and fit measurement. getActivatedReviewKey is a read. Accept, reject, and reply from the balloon call the existing acceptReviewItem, rejectReviewItem, and replyToReviewItem paths, which two-participant tests cover for synchronization, undo, redo, rejoin, and concurrent edits.
